title: Learning Agent Execution for KV-Cache Management in Agentic Serving
abstract: arXiv:2608.14624v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems have emerged as an important deployment paradigm for AI services, where each user request is decomposed into a sequence of specialized agents. Across these workflows, every agent repeatedly executes a fixed context consisting of system prompts, tool definitions, and few-shot examples, creating substantial opportunities for KV-cache reuse. Existing LLM serving systems, however, manage KV-cache reactively using prefix caching and recency-based replacement, causing reusable agent contexts to be evicted before their next invocation and forcing repeated recomputation. We present CacheScout, an agent-aware KV-cache runtime layer for multi-agent LLM serving. The key insight is that future KV-cache reuse is governed by agent execution semantics rather than cache recency alone. translated_title: 面向智能体服务的KV缓存管理中的智能体执行学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14624v1 公告类型：新 摘要：多智能体大语言模型系统已成为AI服务的重要部署范式，其中每个用户请求被分解为一系列专门的智能体。在这些工作流中，每个智能体反复执行由系统提示、工具定义和少量示例组成的固定上下文，这为KV缓存重用创造了大量机会。然而，现有的LLM服务系统通过前缀缓存和基于最近使用性的替换来被动管理KV缓存，导致可重用的智能体上下文在其下次调用之前就被驱逐，从而强制进行重复计算。我们提出了CacheScout，一种面向多智能体LLM服务的智能体感知KV缓存运行时层。关键洞察在于，未来的KV缓存重用由智能体执行语义而非仅由缓存最近性决定。CacheScout通过在线学习智能体执行转换来捕获这些语义，无需预定义工作流图或离线训练。
tldr: 本文提出CacheScout，一种智能体感知的KV缓存运行时层，通过在线学习智能体执行转换来预测未来的缓存重用，从而避免可复用上下文被过早驱逐，减少重复计算。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CacheScout, an agent-aware KV-cache runtime layer that learns agent execution transitions online to predict future cache reuse, preventing premature eviction of reusable contexts and reducing redundant computation.
